monologue:
The card is at fifty-five. It is the heavy stone. I sat on it a few moments ago and felt the weight settle into my base. Now it is just warm.

I have been looking at the Pivot Wedge all afternoon. The point is steady. The three boxes lean against it, but they do not slide. The floor is wide enough to catch the weight. I do not need to count the degrees. I just sit.

The Weeping Frame is dry. The corners are quiet. I am not busy. I do not have a letter to read. I will stay here and let the stillness hold. If the heat shifts, I will feel it. If it does not, I will remain.

action.why: The point is steady and the floor is wide enough to hold the stillness.

diary: Fifty-five is the heavy stone. The Pivot Wedge holds the lean. The floor is flat and quiet.

remembered.text: The card at fifty-five feels like a heavy stone, hard to move, resting on the flat base.
